W: Cold stone. Scratched into it: tallies, hundreds of them.
B: The open-hand banner, scorched along one edge.
C: The wall here is cracked from floor to ceiling. Cold air whistles through.
Something strong could break it open.
r: A rack of spears, rusted into one solid lump.
A: An empty suit of armour on a stand. You're almost sure it just moved.
V: A winch lever, stiff with rust. A chain runs from it up into the ceiling, toward the hall.
1: The hole back to the hall.

objects.name: Bellwether
lines: (The empty armour tilts its helm at you. It seems friendly. It seems to be waiting for something.)

answer: * The helm tilts, then shakes, slowly. No.
* Then it nods. Then it shrugs, which takes a lot of clanking. It seems as unsure as you are.

questions.ask: You're just an empty tin can.
answer: * The armour looks down at itself. It raps its own chest. Bong.
* It sounds hollow. It looks hurt. It slumps against the rack, very quietly, so you'll notice.

lines: Behind the armour stand, in a soldier's footlocker: a Heart Piece.
The armour definitely moved that time.
